howToPlay: Use the basic attack to inflict damage over time on enemies. Utilize the Super to turn enemies against each other and control their actions. Choose between the Dive gadget to avoid damage or the Spellbound gadget to deal instant damage.
gears: Use the Damage gear to increase damage output or the Shield gear to improve survivability. The Gadget Cooldown gear is also useful for more frequent use of Dive or Spellbound.
trait: This controller is ideal for players who excel at manipulating enemy positioning and disrupting team formations.
